facts.fact: 当众展开图纸：山顶豪华滑雪度假村。
facts.anchor: A luxury ski resort built on top of Mount Embercrest.

facts.fact: 点破证据出自国王书房；卫兵拒捕 Micah。
facts.anchor: It was found in your own office.

facts.fact: 讲述畸翅龙群无法捕猎迁徙、正饿死。
指控下毒致突变以腾山建度假村。
国王脱口「蘑菇」自曝；Micah 微笑点破。
facts.anchor: “I never said anything about mushrooms, Your Highness.”

facts.fact: 举瓶示众；人群倒戈，卫兵转向国王。
facts.anchor: Icecap mushroom spores—which are known to be poisonous to dragons.

facts.fact: 卫兵援引古约：龙山圣域、龙为保护物种。
宣布构成废黜罪；上镣逮捕。
facts.anchor: Violating the treaty and deliberately harming a protected species is grounds for dethronement.

facts.fact: 群众掷南瓜送别押走的国王。
facts.anchor: A pumpkin sails through the air.

facts.fact: 林间互道爱意（首次对人说）。
